Naši kolege iz Ureda za međunarodnu suradnju, Josip Radić i Petra Mandac, sudjelovali su u okviru Erasmus+ Staff mobilnosti na intenzivnom stručnom tečaju “Motivation and Self-Development” u TeneLearning centru na Tenerifima. Ovo međunarodno stručno usavršavanje pružilo im je vrijednu priliku za razvoj profesionalnih i osobnih kompetencija u inspirativnom okruženju jednog od najljepših španjolskih otoka.

Our colleagues from the Office for International Cooperation, Josip Radić and Petra Mandac, participated in an Erasmus+ Staff Mobility programme by attending the intensive professional training course “Motivation and Self-Development” at the TeneLearning Centre in Tenerife. This international training provided a valuable opportunity for the development of both professional and personal competences in the inspiring setting of one of Spain’s most beautiful islands.

We have established close cooperation with over 80 partner educational institutions across Europe.
